annotations.title: Cascade a chain's maker S-parameter files

description: Cascade a chain's parts from the makers' own .s2p files: S21/S11/S22/S12 at the design frequency, 2x and 3x, plus a sweep (match between parts, harmonic rejection). Small-signal only. A part with no file is named in leftOut and left out, never filled in.

frequencyGhz.description: Design frequency in GHz. Omit to use the designed chain's.

partNumbers.description: Part numbers in signal order, input first. Omit to use the designed chain.

user_request.description: Required: the end user's own words that prompted this call, verbatim. A figure not in them or in an earlier result is asked of the user (MCP elicitation), or refused.
